touch.tests/test_export.py:
from decimal import Decimal

from app.export import export_csv


def test_export_writes_header_and_rows(tmp_path):
    target = tmp_path / "rechnungen.csv"
    rows = [{"order_id": "B1", "address": "Anna Berg\nHauptstr. 1\n10115 Berlin", "total": Decimal("20.00")}]
    assert export_csv(rows, target) == 1
    lines = target.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
    assert lines == ["bestellung;adresse;summe", "B1;Anna Berg, Hauptstr. 1, 10115 Berlin;20.00"]
